title: Heat through a tie: two blocks of conductivities 10 and 40 with non-matching meshes, 20 and 100 at the ends
source: Series thermal resistances: steady one-dimensional conduction through two layers in perfect contact, T_i = (k1 T0 + k2 T1)/(k1 + k2) and q = ΔT/(L1/k1 + L2/k2) (F. P. Incropera, D. P. DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, §3.1, the composite wall). A linear field in each layer is the exact discrete solution, and the dual mortar tie reproduces a linear temperature across non-matching meshes
